'''Cloud Stalker''' is an [[Advanced enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|A criminal armed with a strange weapon that appears like a harmless lantern. Do not be fooled. The Cloud Stalker's "lantern" is actually a flying decapitator with terrifying reach.}}
